newsitem.title: UK: London shares end election day with record close.
newsitem.headline: London shares end election day with record close.

text.p: UK shares ended a nervous election-day session on Thursday with a closing record but by the slimmest of margins as many investors stayed away ahead of the ballot result which is due in the early hours of Friday morning.
The FTSE 100 index closed 9.0 points higher at a new peak of 4,445.0, only 0.7 points above the previous all-time high of 4,444.3, reached on March 11.
Trading volume was less than 700 million shares, well down on Wednesday's near one billion share turnover amid caution about the size of an expected Labour party victory, dealers said.
